question: How does PL/M-80 V4.0 return one parameterless ADDRESS value to MAIN, and how does MAIN store it in a static ADDRESS?

toolchain.simulator: z80pack Intel Intellec MDS-800 Simulator Release 1.39
toolchain.manual: Intel PL/M-80 Programming Manual, order 9800268B, January 1980, sections 8.1.3 and 8.2
toolchain.overlay_provenance_note: The local recipe labels PLM80 and OV0-OV4 V4.0 and OV5-OV6 V3.1. The compiler banner reports V4.0, but individual overlay opens/use were not traced; actual overlay provenance remains unresolved.

input.syntax_basis: Intel manual typed procedure syntax: type follows PROCEDURE; typed procedures return with RETURN expression; function references may appear in expressions. Exact source accepted with zero program errors.
input.input_terminator: One Ctrl-Z was sent to COPY :CI: as console EOF; it is not part of the 124-byte stored source.

commands: connect /usr/bin/telnet 127.0.0.1 4010; send exactly one ASCII SPACE byte (20H)
COPY each ADRTRN artifact TO :HP:; capture payloads from /tmp/.z80pack/intelmdssim.pt
direct_observations: The listing identifies MAIN at code offset 0000H, size 11; P is a typed ADDRESS procedure at code offset 000BH, size 4, and reports PROCEDURE STACK=0000H.
The listing assigns OBJ data offset 0000H, size 1; RESULT data offset 0001H, size 2. The VARIABLE area is 0003H and LOCATE maps DATA to 369DH-369FH.
At 368BH P executes LXI H,369DH, placing the address of OBJ in HL, followed directly by RET at 368EH.
MAIN calls P at 3683H. The instruction immediately after CALL is SHLD 369EH at 3686H, storing the returned HL value into RESULT.
SHLD stores L at the addressed byte and H at the next byte. For this sample RESULT therefore receives 9DH at 369EH and 36H at 369FH: low byte first.
MAIN initializes SP to 369DH. CALL consumes two stack bytes; direct RET restores SP. Compiler-reported maximum stack is 2 bytes.
The LINK map includes ADRTRN.OBJ(MAIN) only; PLM80.LIB was not needed.
The compiler accepted the source with zero program errors.
sample_specific_interpretation: In this exact no-parameter ADDRESS-return sample, emitted callee code constructs the result in HL and the caller stores it using SHLD. The stored two-byte representation is low-address byte first. This is not asserted as a complete or universal PL/M-80 return ABI.
unresolved_questions: This sample does not test ADDRESS return expressions other than the address of one static BYTE, nested expressions, or returns combined with parameters.
This sample does not establish return behavior for external, recursive, or reentrant procedures, larger results, or other PL/M-80 compiler versions.
